summary: Stage 2, turn 4 sent (design/concepts/WreckedMachines/turn_04.md). His three card answers of 2026-11-26 are taken in and cited: all 18 factory machines are ancient in 0.1.0 (OWNER:1795761534460592124); an Ancient Component is 'Only found in ruins or via plot' (OWNER:1795761550785045693); colonists carry a wreck (OWNER:1795762605668672773). The three asks are answered and three core contradictions are resolved (c_no_way_in, c_half_ancient_factory, c_who_lifts_a_wreck). Measured from the factory mod's defs: the 18 machines by name (17 without Vanilla Cooking Expanded), masses 35 to 115 kg, six supporting parts that stay buildable, no trade tag or reward tag on any of the 18. The Designer's calls, shown to him on the page: each machine leaves the build menu as the smelter does today; a machine that stands in an old save is not changed; one Mod Settings switch per machine; two research projects per machine; a component lies only in ruins, and 'via plot' is read as the campaign's story (marked as a reading); who may lift a wreck is data that the campaign narrows. One finding changes an earlier reading: the alloy forge is one of the 18, so its research step that opens it for building ends when the forge is onboarded (d_forge_is_onboarded; d_riders_fate and d_riders_move_no_interim corrected). That opens one new ask, a_plasteel_on_the_forge: plasteel from a late research project on any working forge (his sentence of 2026-10-09 and the built mod), or as the recipe of the Refurbished forge (one Ancient Component), or both; recommended the Refurbished forge, judged on whether a colony has a reason to spend a component on the forge. One core contradiction is open on that ask (c_plasteel_behind_a_component). A fresh Opus judge (a5105ca4acff55348) struck the first draft, which had decided the plasteel question as a reading and held a false cost line on durasteel; after the corrections its third read passed the ask and the page. The four words 'but notified or built' are still not read. The look that he accepted runs on the Conductor's item RIMMANDRAKE_STAGE_WRECKED_MACHINES_FIRST_LOOK_ONLY_ONE_BUILD_EVER_PLAYED and does not wait for this ask.

quick_look.why: A look cannot settle a_plasteel_on_the_forge: the alloy forge has no Wrecked or Kludged level built, so nothing that runs shows either picture. The look that he accepted on 2026-11-26 (OWNER:1795760440829904733) is already being staged on RIMMANDRAKE_STAGE_WRECKED_MACHINES_FIRST_LOOK_ONLY_ONE_BUILD_EVER_PLAYED; it explores d_three_looks and d_study_before_each_repair.
